newsitem.title: MEXICO: All Mexican ports open, authorities say.
newsitem.headline: All Mexican ports open, authorities say.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Sunday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) and port officials said.
The ministry said in an afternoon bulletin that only Ciudad del Carmen port on the Gulf of Mexico was shut, due to winds of 25-35 kilometers per hour.
But Port Captain Jorge Luis Rios Macbeth told Reuters it had reopened for all shipping at 1400 local/2000 GMT.
The largest crude shipping port Cayo Arcas in Ciudad del Carmen had remained open over the weekend, even though the rest of the ports had been closed, he added.
Mexican crude port Dos Bocas in Tabasco that was shut on Friday due to high winds was open on Sunday, the SCT said.
